gate.intro: Before we continue — have you noticed any of these?

items.label_short: Bladder/bowel change, saddle numbness, or new sexual dysfunction
items.label_full: Trouble starting or controlling wee or bowel motions, or numbness around your bottom or genitals — including new problems with sexual sensation or erection.

items.label_short: New weakness in both legs / can’t walk as usual
items.label_full: New weakness in both legs, or you are suddenly struggling to walk (much worse than your usual).

items.label_short: Chest pain, pressure, or shortness of breath
items.label_full: Chest pain or pressure, or shortness of breath — including if it comes with shoulder, arm, or neck symptoms.

items.label_short: Hot, red, very swollen joint + feverish/unwell
items.label_full: A joint that is hot, red, and very swollen, and you feel feverish or very unwell.

items.label_short: After injury: deformity or can’t weight-bear
items.label_full: After a fall, bang, or twist: the limb or joint looks the wrong shape, or you cannot put weight on it.

items.label_short: Thunderclap headache, or headache + fever + stiff neck
items.label_full: Sudden “worst ever” headache (especially if it peaked within minutes), or headache with fever and a stiff neck.

items.label_short: Unexplained weight loss, or night pain that never eases with position
items.label_full: Unexplained weight loss, or constant night pain that never eases no matter how you lie.

spine_extra_item.label_short: Leg pain that was one side and is now both legs
spine_extra_item.label_full: Pain, pins and needles, or numbness that started in one leg and has spread to both legs.
spine_extra_item.note: NICE CKS warning feature; include on back/sciatica paths.

hard_stop_screen.title: Please get checked now
hard_stop_screen.lead: Some symptoms need a clinician today — not more reading here.
hard_stop_screen.body: Based on what you selected, it’s safest to seek urgent care or call for advice. Symptoms like these are treated as urgent until a clinician says otherwise. This tool cannot assess emergencies.
hard_stop_screen.calm_closer: You’re not overreacting by checking. Better safe.
hard_stop_screen.disclaimer_line: This tool can’t assess emergencies or give a diagnosis.

soft_flags_not_hard_stop: Progressive weakness in one limb only
Night pain that is troublesome but eases when you change position
History of cancer with new bone or spinal pain but no other hard-flag ticks — show Worth getting checked soon banner, not hard stop alone
